subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should OpenClaw accept `announceLastRun` plus non-running `killed` reconciliation as the canonical recovery behavior for aborted subagent completion announce turns after reserving the internal `announce:` idempotency prefix?
rationale: The patch changes persisted session recovery semantics and the Codex/native tool boundary; automation can identify the prefix bug, but maintainers own the final recovery-state and tool-boundary policy choice.

options.title: Fix prefix guard, then merge
options.body: Reject or otherwise reserve public `announce:` idempotency keys, rebase the conflicted branch, rerun lint, and land this as the canonical announce recovery/tool-isolation fix.

options.title: Change the recovery state
options.body: If `killed` is not the desired stored state for aborted delivery-only announce runs, request that state adjustment before merge.

options.title: Pause for broader recovery model
options.body: If maintainers want one model for all inter-session delivery turns, pause this PR and design that owner boundary first.

recommendation.title: Fix prefix guard, then merge
recommendation.body: Reject or otherwise reserve public `announce:` idempotency keys, rebase the conflicted branch, rerun lint, and land this as the canonical announce recovery/tool-isolation fix.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest sampled history across subagent announce and restart/session lifecycle surfaces affected by the decision.
